shortDescription: State Bank of India (SBI) has invited applications for 9124 Junior Associates Clerk posts. Apply online from 11 August 2026 to 31 August 2026.
content:
State Bank of India (SBI) has released the recruitment notification for SBI Junior Associates Clerk 2026 under Advt. No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17.

Applications are open from 11/08/2026 to 31/08/2026. Candidates must read the detailed advertisement for eligibility, language requirements, vacancy distribution and examination pattern.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 11/08/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 31/08/2026
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date: 31/08/2026
  • SBI Clerk Phase I Pre Exam Date: As per schedule
  • Admit Card: Before exam
  • SBI Clerk Phase II Main Exam Date: As per schedule

Application Fee

  • General / EWS / OBC: ₹750
  • SC / ST / PH: ₹0

Fee can be paid through debit card, credit card, net banking or UPI.

Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 20 years
  • Maximum Age: 28 years as on 01/04/2026

Age relaxation is applicable as per SBI Junior Associates Clerk rules.

Vacancy Details

  • Regular Vacancies: 7680
  • Backlog Vacancies: 1444
  • Total: 9124

Vacancies are distributed across states and language zones as per the official SBI notification.
